recs.stt: Driverless robotaxi fleet paralyzed for hours in San Francisco
recs.x:
For the municipiality a 6 lane street vs a two lane street with public transport and bicycle lanes can make the difference between neverending debt and prosperity. Places with good public transport and bicycle infrastructure and denser mixed use pay more tax revenue. Spread out urban sprawls and suburbs give the municipiality a lot of street surface to maintain, for very little tax revenue in return.

A good introduction on that part is the strong towns playlist by the [link] channel Not Just Bikes: [link]

recs.stt: Parking reform legalized most of the new homes in Buffalo and Seattle (2023)
recs.x:
I think everyone should watch the Not Just Bikes YouTube channel especially their series on Strong Towns [1]. It shows just how bad parking mandates are and just how bad American car centric city planning is. As they article pointed out, you need such vanguard cities to pave the way for better cities, with less parking and fingers crossed, fewer cars.
